svg.title: Shepherding (2026)
svg.text: multi-agent reinforcement learning · solo course project · ENSIM / Le Mans Université
A 2D continuous shepherding environment where an RL agent learns to herd sheep into a
goal area, around obstacles, through a curriculum of three levels.
PPO, DQN, SAC and TD3 compared with scripted baselines over 500 test episodes.
